I wrote the solution to `main.wj`. It builds a sieve of Eratosthenes up to 200000 once, then answers each query from precomputed prime-count and largest-prime tables.

I ran Example 2 through `wj run --interpret` and the output matched exactly. I did not run Example 1 separately, and I did not run `wj build`, as instructed.
